description.value: The Tumbler Ridge Community Centre is a multi-facility municipal complex in this small northern BC resource town, housing an arena, aquatic centre, curling rink, fitness area, and indoor play park. Situated in a remote region near the Tumbler Ridge Global Geopark and its renowned dinosaur fossil sites, the centre serves as a hub for community services in one of BC's more isolated communities. For touring cyclists on long-haul northern routes, it may offer a rare opportunity to access indoor facilities in an area with limited services.
